meta.title: BipAgents — your AI agents, at home, in your pocket
meta.description: BipAgents is the app for your own AI agents, built on Hermes Agent. Text them, talk to them or go Live: they work on your computer or server and ask before they act. Free, with open-source code.

hero.lede: BipAgents connects you to your own AI agents, running on your computer or your server. Text them, send a voice note or go Live: they get things done for you, and ask before they act.

1.text: Booked ✅ Pasta Mia, Friday 8:30 pm, for 2.

2.text: Unusual charge: €49.99 “StreamMax”. Do you know it?

3.text: 4 workouts out of 4 this week 💪 Keep it up!

4.text: The washing machine is done. Don’t forget the laundry!

bips.title: One Bip per agent. Each with its own voice.
bips.sub: In the app, every agent is a little mascot with its colour, its mood and its voice. Go on, poke them: they react just like in the app.
bips.hint: Tap, tickle, stroke, long-press… and listen to their voices.

demo.title: Ask. It works. You decide.
demo.sub: This is the app’s own demo. The agent thinks, uses its tools, asks you when there is a choice to make, and waits for your OK before anything that matters.
demo.point1: Every step shown, folded under the reply
demo.point2: Questions with a button for each answer
demo.point3: Your OK before it books, pays or sends

podcast.title: Your morning briefing, as a podcast.
podcast.sub: Your agent writes it from your day — meetings, weather, parcels — and two voices read it to you over coffee. This is the demo’s, recorded in four languages.
podcast.credit: Voices: Fish Audio Drama 3 · Built with Fish Audio

live.title: Just talk. Hands-free.
live.sub: Live is a real conversation with your agent: no button to hold, it answers out loud, and you interrupt it simply by speaking.
live.point1: In English, French, German and Spanish
live.point2: Each agent speaks with its own Bip voice
live.point3: It still asks for your OK on screen before acting

liveDialog.bip: Two meetings, and rain around 5 pm. Shall I remind you to take an umbrella?

liveDialog.you: Remind me to call Mum at 7.
liveDialog.bip: Done: a reminder at 7 pm, with her number.

liveDialog.you: Is it cold in the living room?
liveDialog.bip: 18.5 °C. I can turn it up to 21 — just confirm on screen.

control.title: They act. You keep the keys.
control.sub: Mail, the web, your smart home: your agents use the tools you give them, and ask you first before anything sensitive.
control.approvalTitle: Send the booking in your name?
control.approvalCommand:
Book: Pasta Mia · Friday 8:30 pm
2 people

card1.title: Your OK, in one tap
card1.text: Once, for this session, or no — right from the notification.

card2.title: A browser you can watch
card2.text: Each agent has its own Chrome on its own desktop. Watch it live, and take the mouse for a captcha or a password.

card3.title: Agents that team up
card3.text: Your agents ask each other — only the ones you allow — and the exchange folds into a single line.

privacy.title: Your data stays home.
privacy.sub: Your conversations, files and memory live on your computer or server. Your messages go from your phone to your server, then to the AI model you chose: a cloud API, or one running at home.
privacy.nope: Kerfy Studio, the app’s publisher, never sees your conversations

install.title: One command. Then scan.
install.sub: Pick a machine that stays on: a Mac, a Linux PC, Windows 11, or a small rented server from about €8 a month. No GPU needed.

step1.title: A machine that stays on
step1.text: Your computer, a mini PC, or a small server in the cloud.

step2.title: Run the command
step2.text: It asks a few questions, shows what it will set up, then installs everything.

step3.title: Scan the QR code
step3.text: In the app: + › Scan QR code. Your Bips say hello.

install.out2: ✓ The bridge and the Bips’ voices
install.out3: ✓ It’s ready! Scan this code in the app.
install.hermes: Already running Hermes Agent? The same command plugs the app into it, without touching your model, your tools, your platforms or your agents. It shows everything it will change before it starts.

extra1.title: The whole family
extra1.text: One server for everyone: each person gets their own install, their own agents and their own data.

extra2.title: Move anytime
extra2.text: From a rented server to a computer at home, or to a cheaper host: your agents move with their memory, in one command.

extra3.title: Open source
extra3.text: The code is public under the MIT license: read it, run it, make it better.

1.a: Yes. The app is free, with no in-app purchases. You only pay for your server and your AI model, if they cost anything.

2.a: No. Cloud models work great on any machine. A model running at home is possible too, if you have the hardware.

3.q: Which AI models can I use?
3.a: The ones Hermes Agent supports: OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, or a model running at home with LM Studio or any OpenAI-compatible server.

4.a: Your server and the model provider you chose. Not us: Kerfy Studio never sees your conversations, and notifications go through our relay without the text of your messages.

5.a: Both, and iPad too. In English, French, German and Spanish.

6.a: The open-source AI agent by Nous Research. BipAgents is an independent app built on it: it turns your Hermes agents into Bips you take everywhere.

7.q: Can I try it without a server?
7.a: Yes: the app has a built-in demo with four Bips, invented data and the morning podcast. Nothing is sent anywhere.

end.title: Meet your Bips.
end.sub: Free on iPhone, iPad and Android, very soon. Until then, the code is on GitHub.

foot.about: BipAgents is the app for your own AI agents, by Kerfy Studio. Built on Hermes Agent, open-source software by Nous Research; BipAgents is an independent app.
